title: 气候模型之不确定性
text: 屏幕上闪烁的彩色等值线勾勒出全球气温升高的潜在趋势。这些数字化模拟旨在量化温室气体排放与地表温度之间的复杂关系。然而，数值预测并非绝对真理，而是在概率区间内的推演。气候敏感度作为核心参数，其波动直接影响最终结果。大气环流的非线性特征使得微小扰动可能引发剧烈变化。这种现象在数学上被称为混沌状态。云层反馈机制是目前最难量化之环节。水汽凝结与辐射强度的相互作用极其微妙。不同研究机构采用的参数化方案存在显著差异。这种异质性导致了模型间预测结果的离散。海洋热含量吸收速率的不确定性亦不可忽视。深海循环的减缓速度尚未达成共识。冰盖融化的临界点具有高度不可预测性。地表反照率的改变会形成正反馈循环。这种级联效应增加了长期预估的难度。随机过程在气候系统中扮演关键角色。结构性误差源于物理过程的简化描述。为了降低偏差，科学家引入了多模型集成方法。通过加权平均，研究者试图抵消单一模型的系统性缺陷。尽管如此，极端天气的发生频率依然难以精确捕捉。这种不确定性并非意味着科学失效。相反，它界定了人类认知的边界。精准的风险评估必须包含对未知变量的考量。决策者应在概率分布基础上制定适应策略。面对动态演变的生态系统，审慎的态度至关重要。

questions.prompt: According to the text, what does a numeric climate prediction actually represent?
options: An inference within a probability interval, not an absolute truth
A guaranteed, precise forecast of future temperatures
A purely political construct with no scientific basis
An exact calculation with zero margin of error

questions.prompt: What does the text describe as the hardest element to quantify in climate models?
options: The cloud feedback mechanism
Ocean heat content absorption rate
Ice-sheet melting timing
Surface temperature measurement

questions.prompt: Why do different research institutions' climate models produce different predictions, according to the text?
options: Because they use significantly different parameterization schemes
Because they are intentionally testing opposite hypotheses
Because only one institution has access to real data
Because older institutions use outdated equipment exclusively

questions.prompt: What method do scientists use to reduce bias in climate predictions, according to the text?
options: A multi-model ensemble approach using weighted averaging
Relying exclusively on a single, most powerful supercomputer
Ignoring older data in favor of only the newest observations
Eliminating all models except the one closest to observed data

questions.prompt: What does the text conclude that uncertainty in climate science actually means?
options: It defines the boundary of human cognition rather than indicating scientific failure
It proves that climate science is fundamentally unreliable
It means policy decisions should be delayed indefinitely
It shows that scientists disagree about whether climate change is occurring

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.
